ecu.title: ECM & ECU Repair Johor Bahru | Car ECU Repair for Workshops | EMATS
ecu.description: ECM and ECU repair in Johor Bahru at component level. Car ECU repair for workshops: diagnosis before quote, repair and bench test, send-in service.
ecu.h1: ECU and ECM Repair in Johor Bahru
ecu.intro: Car ECU repair for workshops: EMATS repairs engine control units (ECU) and ECM boards at component level in Johor Bahru. When a car will not start, will not talk to the scan tool or keeps throwing the same fault after the wiring checks out, the module itself may be the problem, and it can often be repaired rather than replaced.

sections.h2: When a workshop sends us an ECU
p: Workshops usually send an ECU once the obvious checks are done: power, earth, fuses and wiring are good, but the fault stays. These are common reasons a module comes to our bench:
list: No communication with the diagnostic tool
Car cranks but will not start, with power and wiring confirmed
Injector, ignition or sensor circuit faults that point back to the ECU
Water damage, corrosion or burnt parts on the board
Intermittent cut-outs that follow the module, not the wiring

p: We open the case, inspect the board and power the module up on a test setup. That lets us find the failed part, whether it is a driver chip, a power supply component, a cracked solder joint or a damaged track.
Before anything is repaired, you get the fault and the cost. If you go ahead, we repair the board at component level and test the module again on the bench before it goes back.

An ECM that has stopped working often has one failed area, not a dead board. Repairing the original unit means it stays the module that came out of that car, and you avoid hunting for a replacement that may still need setting up.

faq.q: Is an ECU and an ECM the same thing?
faq.a: Both names are used for the engine control unit, the computer that runs the engine. We repair both at component level.

faq.q: What should I send with the ECU?
faq.a: Just the module, with the car model, the fault you saw and the part number from the label. See the workshop guide for the full list.

faq.q: Will you tell me the cost first?
faq.a: Yes. Diagnosis comes before the quote, and no repair starts until you agree.

abs.title: ABS Module Repair Malaysia | Johor Bahru | EMATS
abs.description: ABS module repair in Malaysia from Johor Bahru: ABS control modules checked and repaired at component level for workshops. Diagnosis before quote.
abs.intro: ABS module repair in Malaysia for workshops, done on the bench in Johor Bahru. When the ABS warning light stays on and the sensors, wiring and pump have checked out, the fault is often inside the ABS control module. EMATS checks the module and repairs the board at component level, so the answer does not always have to be a new unit.

sections.h2: Signs the ABS module itself is at fault
p: We see ABS modules from workshops after the usual checks. Typical reasons they come in:
list: ABS or traction warning light that stays on after sensor and wiring checks
No communication with the ABS module on the scan tool
Module-related fault codes that return after clearing
Intermittent faults that come and go with heat or vibration

sections.h2: How we repair an ABS control module
p: The electronic part of the ABS unit is checked on the bench. We look for failed components, cracked solder joints and damaged tracks on the board, then tell you the fault and the cost before any repair.
Once you agree, the board is repaired at component level and the module is tested on the bench before it goes back to your workshop.

sections.h2: Remove and refit stays with your workshop
p: Your workshop removes the module, sends it in and refits it after the repair. Ask us on WhatsApp first with the part number, and we will tell you exactly what to send.

faq.q: Do you repair the whole ABS unit?
faq.a: We work on the electronic control module, the board that controls the ABS. Send the part number first and we will confirm what to send.

faq.q: Can you check an ABS module before I buy a new one?
faq.a: Yes. That is what diagnosis before quote is for: you learn the fault and the repair cost first, then decide.

cluster.title: Instrument Cluster Repair Johor Bahru | EMATS
cluster.description: Instrument cluster repair in Johor Bahru: dead gauges, display and lighting faults repaired at component level for workshops. Diagnosis before quote.
cluster.h1: Instrument Cluster Repair in Johor Bahru
cluster.intro: Instrument cluster repair in Johor Bahru for workshops and car owners. When gauges stop moving, the display goes blank or the cluster lighting fails, the fault is usually on the cluster board. EMATS powers the cluster up on the bench, finds the failed part and repairs it at component level.

p: These are common reasons an instrument cluster comes to the bench:
list: Speedometer, rev counter, fuel or temperature gauge stuck or dead
Display that is blank, dim or missing segments
Cluster lighting or warning lights not working
Cluster that is completely dead or keeps resetting

p: We power the cluster on the bench, outside the car, so the fault can be found on the board itself. You get the fault and the cost before any repair, and the cluster is tested again on the bench after the repair.
Repairing the cluster that came out of the car keeps the original unit in the car, so you do not need to source and set up a replacement.

faq.q: Do I need to send the whole cluster?
faq.a: Yes, send the instrument cluster as it came out of the dashboard, with the car model and the fault you saw.

faq.q: Do car owners use this service?
faq.a: Mostly workshops send clusters in, but car owners can message us too. A workshop will usually remove and refit it.
